manifest.name: Text+
manifest.author: Zoidium
manifest.description: Adds per-character animation and 3D face materials to Text, plus advanced 3D bevel controls.

objectTypes.name: Text+
objectTypes.desc: Transform, blend, shake, select, or scatter descendant 3D Text characters.

objectClasses.name: Character Transform
objectClasses.description: Applies position, rotation, scale, and staggered timing to every text character while preserving Text geometry settings.

objectClasses.name: Gradient Transform
objectClasses.description: Interpolates position, rotation, and scale from the first character to the last.

objectClasses.name: Character Shake
objectClasses.description: Applies phase-driven axis-based rotational shake with per-character phase offsets.

objectClasses.name: Selected Character Transform
objectClasses.description: Applies position, rotation, scale, and staggered timing only to the entered character numbers.

objectClasses.name: Selected Character Shake
objectClasses.description: Applies phase-driven axis-based rotational shake only to the entered character numbers.

objectClasses.name: Random Scatter
objectClasses.description: Applies deterministic random position, rotation, and scale ranges to each text character.

objectClasses.name: Character Material
objectClasses.description: Assigns front and side materials to selected descendant 3D Text characters.
